sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-live-desk-2026-10-02-r1/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: 'Quality Checks' sheet row 10 (check 9) and 'Internal Quality Checks' sheet row 10 (check 9, no extra annotation cells on that row)
evidence: Static review of the frozen bytes (task.toml sha256 71f1802d...6734da and environment/Dockerfile sha256 0a75419e...2467d1, both matching manifest.json lines 28 and 10). task/task.toml [environment] block (lines 22-26): build_timeout_sec = 600.0, network_mode = "public", cpus = 2, memory_mb = 4096. These equal the values in staged-task-contract.md lines 58-60 and the block from [agent] to end of file is byte-identical to the frozen template task.toml (diff empty). No docker_image, allow_internet, allowed_hosts, gpus or storage_mb key exists anywhere in task.toml (grep empty), satisfying quality-checks.md line 44 and staged-task-contract.md line 78. No secret literal under [environment]; the only credential-shaped entries are in [verifier.env] (lines 31-35): ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}" is a ${VAR} template and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = "" is empty, both expected by SKILL.md line 66 and identical to the template. task/environment/Dockerfile (26 lines) is byte-identical to the template Dockerfile: node:22-bookworm-slim, apt ca-certificates/git/procps/sqlite3, global express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1, COPY of instructions/ and assets/ only, no ENV/ARG carrying a credential (only NODE_PATH, line 3; git identity turing@local.invalid, line 20). A secret-pattern grep over the whole frozen task (api key, secret, token, password, bearer, sk-, AKIA, PRIVATE KEY) returned only the intentional demo password Hireops!2026 in instruction.md line 19, hireops_rules.md lines 25 and 359 and tests/app_context.md line 8, plus session-token code in the solution; seed_data.json has no password/secret/token/key field names. 2 CPUs and 4096 MB are sane for one Node 22 + Express + better-sqlite3 process (integration.md lines 1-10) with no build toolchain or bundler required. network_mode = "public" is correct per the workbook row and SKILL.md line 26 and is not flagged. Weak-app/alternative probe: a submission that fetches CDN assets or installs at solve time is permitted under public network (quality-checks.md line 45), so the posture neither admits a broken app nor rejects a conforming one. Limitation: this row was reviewed from source only; I did not build the agent image or measure memory use, and raw-evidence-index.json holds no agent-image resource measurement. The row's Verify list is static configuration, so I do not treat that as required missing evidence for this row; image build behaviour belongs to row 15.
